description: Fetch the full profile of a single company by IČO (8-digit Slovak company ID). Returns: legal name, legal form, status, address, statutory bodies (people with roles), business activities, and up to 10 most recent financial filings (revenue, assets, equity, net income). Data is cached from source registers (RÚZ, RPO, ORSR, FS DPH) with lazy-refresh if stale.
name: get_company
